item.title: 'A big impact': Orchard Park students go all out for PJs for P.U.N.T. fundraiser
item.description: Over the past four years, the Orchard Park Central School District has raised more than $40,000 for P.U.N.T. Pediatric Collaborative.

item.title: Extreme cold continues to cause water main breaks across Western New York
item.description: The extreme cold continues to cause water main breaks across Western New York. In the last week, we have reported on at least five water main breaks across the region.

item.title: Chandler Street Breweries opens in Buffalo's Black Rock neighborhood
item.description: A new beer destination has opened in Buffalo's Black Rock neighborhood, bringing together three local brewing companies under one roof at the renovated Chandler Street Breweries.

item.title: ‘Only a fool would go back’: Frustration grows as Candlelight Cabinetry extends employee furlough
item.description: Employees at Candlelight Cabinetry in Lockport received an email from HR saying that the company-wide furlough will “continue,” one worker saying, “there’s no way” anybody has a job to return to.
